## Pull request overview

Adds a new `@objectstack/plugin-auth` workspace package to scaffold authentication integration in ObjectStack (plugin lifecycle + route registration + service registration), and updates docs to reference the new plugin/service.

**Changes:**
- Introduces `packages/plugins/plugin-auth` with `AuthPlugin`, route scaffolding for `/api/v1/auth/*`, and basic unit tests.
- Updates documentation to list the new plugin package and register `auth` as a standard service.
- Updates the monorepo lockfile to include the new workspace package resolution.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 13 out of 14 changed files in this pull request and generated 8 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| pnpm-lock.yaml | Adds lock entries for the new `plugin-auth` workspace package and related dependencies. |
| packages/plugins/plugin-auth/package.json | Defines the new plugin package metadata, deps, and scripts. |
| packages/plugins/plugin-auth/tsconfig.json | TypeScript build configuration for the new package. |
| packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/index.ts | Public entrypoint exporting the plugin and spec types. |
| packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts | Implements `AuthPlugin` lifecycle, service registration, and auth route scaffolding with stub manager. |
| packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.test.ts | Adds unit tests covering init/start/destroy and basic config behaviors. |
| packages/plugins/plugin-auth/examples/basic-usage.ts | Provides a basic kernel usage example wiring server + auth plugin. |
| packages/plugins/plugin-auth/README.md | Documents plugin status, usage, configuration, and scaffolded routes. |
| packages/plugins/plugin-auth/IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md | Summarizes what was added and planned next steps. |
| packages/plugins/plugin-auth/CHANGELOG.md | Adds an initial changelog entry for the new package. |
| content/docs/guides/kernel-services.mdx | Updates auth service status to “In Development” and points to `@objectstack/plugin-auth`. |
| content/docs/concepts/packages.mdx | Adds `@objectstack/plugin-auth` to the package reference and updates package counts. |
| content/docs/concepts/core/services.mdx | Adds `auth` to the standard services table. |
| README.md | Adds `@objectstack/plugin-auth` to the root plugin list. |
</details>


<details>
<summary>Files not reviewed (1)</summary>

* **pnpm-lock.yaml**: Language not supported
</details>

`better-auth` is recorded as a direct dependency for the `packages/plugins/plugin-auth` importer in the lockfile, which contradicts `plugin-auth/package.json` (it’s only an optional peerDependency). This pulls in a large dependency graph (including packages with Node >=20.19 engines), which can break installs on the repo’s Node >=18 support. Regenerate the lockfile after ensuring `better-auth` is not in `dependencies`/`devDependencies` for this workspace (keep it as optional peer only).

The package JSDoc claims this plugin is “Powered by better-auth”, but the implementation is explicitly a stub and does not integrate better-auth yet. This is misleading for consumers; adjust the wording to reflect that better-auth integration is planned/future work.
```suggestion
 * Planned integration with better-auth for robust, secure authentication
```

`AuthPluginOptions` extends `Partial<AuthConfig>`, which makes `secret` optional at the type level, but `init()` throws if `secret` is missing. Make `secret` required in the options type (e.g., override `secret` to be required) so TypeScript matches runtime behavior.

This plugin fetches the HTTP server service using the legacy key `'http-server'`, but the canonical service name in the codebase is `'http.server'` (with `'http-server'` only as a compatibility alias). Prefer `'http.server'` here to align with the rest of the runtime and avoid depending on the alias.

This changelog entry claims full better-auth integration, session management, OAuth providers, CSRF protection, rate limiting, etc., but the current implementation is route scaffolding that throws “not yet implemented”. Please rewrite this entry to accurately describe what is actually delivered in 2.0.2 (plugin structure + route scaffolding + service registration) and move the rest to “Planned”/future versions.

The docs list the `auth` service contract as `IAuthService`, but there is no `IAuthService` interface/type in the codebase (no matches under `packages/`). Either define/publish the `IAuthService` contract (e.g., in core/spec contracts) or update the docs to reference the actual service type currently registered by `plugin-auth`.
```suggestion
| `auth` | _See `plugin-auth` docs_ | `plugin-auth` |
```

This example falls back to a hard-coded default `secret` when `AUTH_SECRET` is not set. For an auth plugin, that can lead to insecure deployments if someone copies the example as-is. Prefer failing fast when `AUTH_SECRET` is missing, or make the example explicitly mark the fallback as development-only and unsafe for production.

`@objectstack/plugin-auth` is set to version `2.0.2`, while other workspace packages are on `2.0.3`. If this repo uses a fixed-version releases across packages, this will create inconsistent publishing and docs links; consider aligning this package version (and its changelog header/compare links) to the current workspace version.
